question: On which lunar days should the mantra-knower perform this rite?
premises: The rite is performed by a mantra-knower.
The specified days are the sixth and the fourteenth.
These days fall in the dark fortnight.
inference: The mantra-knower should perform the rite on the sixth and fourteenth days of the dark fortnight.
plain_english: The mantra-knower should do this on the sixth and on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight.
